# Proto-Resomi
Parts of the romantic movement within resomi society have embraced full cybernetic augmentation like some of their Avali forbearers did before them. Although even within their own movement this is seen as the more extreme and rather opulent kind of veneration. Other resomi outside of the movement of course view this practice as highly vain. The [color=#ffbc48]Nexus[/color] is the only exception to this.
## Racial Features - Their blood is ammonia-based and has a distinct purple color, it is metabolised from copper and it has a [color=#ffa500]severe allergic reaction to iron[/color]. - They requires a special chemical, Amoxla, to heal airloss damage. - Regular [color=#ffa500]airloss chemicals are extremely deadly[/color] to them. - They are more frail, [color=#ffa500]falling into crit at 85 damage and dying at 170 damage[/color]. - They take [color=#ffa500]65% more Cold damage[/color] and [color=#1fb0ff]25% less heat damage[/color]. - On top of that, they receive [color=#1fb0ff](10%-30%-40%) slash and piercing damage resistance[/color] depending on their cybernetic choice. (Access your species specific loadout from the Appearance tab) - They have a [color=#1fb0ff]Built in MIDI player[/color] - Due to their mixed mechanical and biological nature, they can [color=#1fb0ff]heal with both chemicals and topicals, and welders and wires[/color], however [color=#ffa500]both methods are only 50% effective[/color]. - They are [color=#ffa500]damaged slightly and immobilised by EMPs[/color]. - They have an in-built [color=#1fb0ff]Trinary Radio Channel accessed with the key :D[/color] - They can talk over [color=#ffbc48]The Nexus with :x[/color]. - Thanks to their claws they deal [color=red]5[/color] slash damage with their unarmed attacks. - Their standard body heat is -10 degrees Celcius and they [color=#1e90ff]can withstand temperatures between -50 and 40 degrees Celcius[/color]. - They are able to jump long distances once every 30 seconds.
## Nightvision Resomi have a innate nightvision thanks to their eyes. This allows them to see in pure darkness farther than any normal lightsource would allow. They will have normal vision when wearing any equipment that provides flash immunity. Using HUD variants allows you to keep your innate vision, at the cost of losing flash immunity. You can configure if you start with glasses or HUD in the loadouts for all relevant roles.
## Flash Duration Due to their eyes being more sensitive to light, Resomi will be stunned for a longer duration when flashed. Flashes will take [color=yellow]2[/color] times as long as normal for other species, lasting up to [color=#ffa500]10[/color] seconds in the case of a localized flash.
## Weapon Knockback Resomi are incredibly lightweight, and thus they have difficulty using weapons that are any bigger than pistols or SMGs. Shooting any other weapon will cause them to take stamina damage and get pushed back. Rocket launchers, since they are recoil-less, will actually [color=red]pull Resomi forward with the rocket[/color] for a short distance. Stamina resistance will help mitigate some of the effects of knockback, but will never completely negate it.
## Scratch and Trinary The Resomi language, known as Scratch, is composed of a series of screeches, caws and throat sounds. It is often described as fast paced and sharp, easily pronounceable by most species with some practice. In addition, Resomi share this language with Avali. Like all other Protogens, they are also able to speak and understand Trinary, a language similar to binary but able to be spoken by most synthetics.
## Age and Names Resomi are a long lived species, reaching adulthood around 23 years of age and being capable of living for 430 years. Their names are given to them upon hatching, often consisting of a first name, followed by a pack name.
